Subject: Dual-track Renewal QBR: Exec roadmap + Technical workshop — proposed windows

Hi Lindsey —

Thanks again for the renewal signal — excited to align on next steps. For this cycle we recommend a split 'dual-track' QBR so stakeholders get the right level of detail:

- Track A (Exec / Product): 60 minutes — roadmap & commercial summary (high-level roadmap, renewal terms, value realized).
- Track B (Hands-on / Tech): 90 minutes — deep-dive on integration roadmap, performance tuning (batching/cache), migration paths to Dedicated/Private.

Proposed windows (all PT):
- Option 1: Tue Nov 21 morning (9:00–11:30) — exec 9:00–10:00, tech 10:15–11:45
- Option 2: Thu Nov 23 morning (9:00–11:30) — same split
- Backup: Mon Nov 27 afternoon (1:00–4:00) if you prefer consolidated time.

Attached: QBR_Agenda_v2.pdf and Roadmap_Slides_prep.pptx (short stubs). Can you share which session your leadership will attend and any absolute blackout dates? If helpful we can offer a condensed one-and-a-half hour combined session but we find the split gives better outcomes.

Also tagging a few internal folks who would lead: Marissa (renewal exec), Rishi (SE lead), Soojin (CS).

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Mina —

Thanks for laying this out. Leadership bandwidth is tight the week of Nov 20 — they can do a one-hour exec-only window on Fri Nov 17 between 1:30–3:30 PT (we can do 45–60 min inside that). Our engineering org is only available the week after Thanksgiving (Nov 28–Dec 1) in the mornings PT.

Rahul (cc) will coordinate attendees. Two asks from our side:
1) Please include a brief renewal summary (current usage, proposed commitment tiers, expected cost delta) in the exec deck.
2) For the technical session, can you confirm if you’ll bring an SE to walk our infra team through KV cache and batching best practices?

If those constraints are a blocker we can look at consolidating into a 90–120 minute combined session on Mon Nov 27 afternoon, but we prefer split if feasible.

— Lindsey
